# Section 2 - Error Handler (Error Workflow)

Owned By: Jan Wendell Mesia
Last Updated: Aug 4, 2026

Error workflow that captures failures from linked workflows and
reports error details to the Academy endpoint.

## Notes
- This uses two other workflows from section 3 (Failure Test and Debugging Practice workflows)

## Trigger
- Error Trigger: Fires when a linked workflow fails in production

## Data Captured
- workflow.name: Name of failed workflow
- workflow.id: Workflow ID
- execution.url: Link to failed execution
- execution.error.message: Error details
- execution.lastNodeExecuted: Node that failed

## Endpoint
- POST /webhook/course/n8n103/error-report

## Requirements
- Must be published to be used as an error workflow
- Only triggers on production executions, not manual tests

Part of: n8n Foundations Program, N8N103 Course, Section 2
